blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Renewable energy advocates have urged Oriental Mindoro cooperatives to expand solar financing programs to make clean, affordable electricity more accessible to households, farmers, fisherfolk, and small businesses. They made the call during the Provincial Cooperatives’ Summit on Renewable Energy held in Calapan City on Friday, which encouraged cooperatives to use their microfinancing networks to help households and small enterprises acquire solar energy systems and reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. Gerry Arances, executive editor of environmental crusader Center for Energy, Ecology, and Development, said financing opportunities were necessary to make the transition to renewable energy affordable […]...
